summary: First test pass on CRacker Pro backend + frontend. Created pytest suite (24 tests) covering auth, dashboard, masters, projects, lines, excel upload, approvals, audit, admin, brute-force. Backend 24/24 passing AFTER 3 root-cause fixes were applied. Frontend login → dashboard → KPI tiles → currency toggle work. Found 1 production-impacting bug (excel upload corrupts customers listing) plus 1 architectural issue (brute-force IP-tracking).

critical.issue: Returns 500 ResponseValidationError when any customer.phone is stored as int. Excel upload accepts numeric phone values from xlsx (openpyxl coerces '+91...' or numeric strings to int) and writes int into mongo. CustomerOut.phone is Optional[str] so listing fails for ALL users until bad row is removed. Fix: coerce phone (and similar string fields) to str in excel_utils.parse_xlsx, OR change CustomerOut.phone to accept str|int|None.
RevenueLineIn / CostLineIn required project_id in request body even though it is set from path. Frontend would receive 422. FIXED by making project_id Optional in models.py.

Returned 500 PydanticSerializationError 'Unable to serialize ObjectId' because write_audit() received the same dict that motor.insert_one had mutated to include _id (ObjectId). FIXED in services.write_audit by stripping _id from field_changes.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout key is ip:email. K8s preview ingress rotates source IP across pods → lockout triggers after ~7-10 attempts instead of advertised 5. Use email-only key or trust X-Forwarded-For.
Audit field_changes is the entire payload dict; for large updates this duplicates project payloads (e.g. ~30 fields with old/new). Consider whitelisting changed keys.

field_changes=doc passed to write_audit AFTER insert_one mutates doc with _id. Currently masked by our write_audit fix but the call sites should pass payload.model_dump() (clean) instead of the mutated doc.

ui_bugs.issue: Tabs 'Overview/Revenue/Cost/Milestones/Audit' could not be found via get_by_role('tab', name=...). Likely shadcn Tabs without role attribute or name mismatch. Add data-testid='tab-overview', tab-revenue, tab-cost, tab-milestones, tab-audit for testability.

integration_issues.issue: Could not robustly target sidebar 'Suppliers/Employees/Excel Upload/Approvals/Audit Trail/User Management/Approval Matrix' links by role=link. They render but selector ambiguity caused all clicks to land on /customers. Add data-testid='sidebar-{key}' to nav anchors for deterministic testing.
If GET /api/customers returns 500 (see backend HIGH bug) the page would blank out. No graceful empty/error state observed during failure window.

issues: Premium dark+gold theme renders well; KPI tiles + 4 charts (Stage Distribution, Recognized vs Billed, Top Customers, Vendor Exposure) all visible. No contrast issues observed.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): excel_utils.parse_xlsx must coerce string-typed schema fields (phone, sap_customer_code, employee_code, etc.) to str; OR loosen CustomerOut/EmployeeOut/SupplierOut typing. This is a production data-corruption hazard.
FIX (MEDIUM): Brute-force lockout - track by email only (or X-Forwarded-For real IP) so the 5-attempt SLA is honoured behind the k8s ingress.

FIX (MEDIUM): Add data-testid attributes for sidebar nav (sidebar-projects, sidebar-customers, ... sidebar-approval-matrix) and project detail tabs (tab-overview/revenue/cost/milestones/audit). Currently only KPI tiles + login form have data-testid.
ENHANCE (LOW): Audit log field_changes dedup - update routes pass payload.model_dump() not the post-insert dict; reduce noise in audit trail.
critical_code_review_comments: services.write_audit now defensively strips _id; but root cause is callers passing the mutated insert dict — fix at call sites by passing payload.model_dump() (or filtering keys) for cleaner audit trail.
auth.set_auth_cookies uses samesite='none' + secure=True — correct for cross-origin preview, but combined with Bearer tokens the cookie path is largely redundant. Document the primary auth mechanism.
server.py is 956 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Split into routers per domain (auth, masters, projects, approvals, uploads, dashboard, audit) for maintainability.
approval engine (services.find_matching_rule) returns FIRST matching rule in DB order; for two overlapping rules behaviour is unstable. Add priority field or sort.
Excel parse uses openpyxl default cell types — phone numeric coercion is a class of bugs. Add per-column type coercion in SCHEMAS.
updated_files: /app/backend/services.py (write_audit strips _id from field_changes to prevent ObjectId serialization 500s)

success_rate.frontend: 70% (login + dashboard + KPI verified; sidebar/tabs deferred due to selector issues)

test_credentials: admin@crackerpro.com / Admin@123 (seeded). Verified bcrypt hash ($2b$) via successful login.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Test suite cleans its own TEST_-prefixed records (customers, projects, users) and login_attempts. Reset login_attempts: `mongosh cracker_pro --eval 'db.login_attempts.deleteMany({})'`.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_crackerpro.py – run with `pytest backend/tests/test_crackerpro.py -v`. Before running, clear login_attempts. Two backend fixes already applied (models.py + services.py); the customer-phone-type bug is NOT fixed (E1 must coerce). For frontend retest: add data-testid to sidebar links + project detail tabs first; then verify navigation, project detail tabs, approvals approve/reject, audit filters, admin user create+reset password, approval matrix add/edit rule. Currency toggle and KPI tiles confirmed working.
rca_of_the_issues: 1) GET /api/audit 500: write_audit() received post-insert mongo dict containing ObjectId _id; FastAPI's default jsonable_encoder failed to serialize. 2) Revenue/Cost create 422: model required project_id which is supplied via path. 3) GET /api/customers 500 after upload: openpyxl reads numeric-looking phone cells as int; backend stored int; CustomerOut Pydantic schema requires str. 4) Brute force: identifier includes request.client.host which in k8s preview is the ingress pod IP (rotates), so per-IP counter never reaches 5 reliably.
